editorial:
Imagine a spooky Halloween night where Bugs Bunny decides to dress up as a witch just for a laugh. He ends up at the door of Witch Hazel, a grumpy old lady who thinks she is the ugliest person in the world. The vibe is classic cartoon chaos, mixing creepy mansion settings with the kind of silly humor that never gets old. You get to see a great battle of wits between a smug rabbit and a magical witch who is absolutely losing her mind. It is short, punchy, and feels like a cozy autumn treat that you can enjoy with the whole family.

What really makes this work is the fast pacing and the funny facial expressions. The animation is smooth, and the way Witch Hazel flies around is still impressive today. It is a quick watch, but it delivers plenty of laughs. Anyone who likes slapstick comedy will love this one.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up when Bugs Bunny completely tricks Witch Hazel into thinking he is actually uglier than she is. He uses a mirror and some clever jokes to mess with her head. In the end, the witch is so shocked and frustrated that she cannot handle his sarcasm. Bugs manages to escape her clutches and leaves her fuming in her own house, proving once again that he is the smartest character in the room.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic cartoons and Halloween vibes.
